newsitem.title: GERMANY: Weru says first-half profits dip.
newsitem.headline: Weru says first-half profits dip.

text.p: German window and door maker Weru AG said on Friday that pre-tax profits fell by 1.7 million marks in the first half of this year to seven million marks.
Chief executive Juergen Bockstette told the company's annual shareholders' meeting that first half sales were 190.1 million marks, down from 205.6 million a year earlier.
He said sales would fall again 1997 after they slipped in 1996, but forecast that earnings would be in line with plans.

Group sales fell last year to 452.8 million marks from 500.6 million marks, but income on ordinary activities rose to 31.5 million marks from 15.5 million. Management proposed an unchange dividend for 1996 of 14 marks plus a two-mark bonus.
